name: Stat Checks
author: ct
description: Stat checks for any scenario: `check cha 12 [dice=d20] [bonus=2] [else=label] -> :success` rolls a stat plus dice against a difficulty, shows the outcome line and branches (a novel's persuasion, a tile RPG's locked door). The roll is left in dialog variables (check_total, check_roll, …) for ptext lines. Dice default to the game setting checks.dice, else d20; dice=none makes a plain threshold. The conditional jump `when` and option conditions live in dialog_base.
